name: io.eccasion.portal/cars
title: Eccasion cars
description: Search the used cars currently for sale or auction on Eccasion, by make, price, year and more.

tools.name: search_cars
tools.description:
Search the used cars currently for sale on Eccasion, a Dutch online car platform (portal.eccasion.io) selling mostly ex-lease electric cars through online auctions and fixed-price "buy now" offers, each with a 12-month warranty.

Filters and sorts the live listing (refreshed every 60 seconds) and returns the number of matching cars, up to `limit` of them (default 20, max 50), a link to the same search on the website, and the makes and colours on offer right now.

Prices: `price_eur` includes VAT and the Eccasion service fee. For an auction (`sale_type` "auction") it is a "from" price, the minimum rather than the final price, and the auction closes at `auction_ends_at`. For "buy_now" it is a fixed price.

Always give the user each car's `url`: photos, details, bidding and buying are on the website. Car pages are in Dutch; for English insert `/en` after the host (e.g. https://portal.eccasion.io/en/cars/{id}), keeping the query.

All filters are optional and combine with AND; the values in one list match any of them. A make, model or colour with no live car matches nothing and is listed in `not_found`.

makes.description: Only cars of these makes (and models); a car matching any entry is included. Omit for every make. `available_makes` in the result lists the makes on offer right now.

make.description: Make name, e.g. "Tesla", "Volkswagen" or "Škoda". Case, accents and spaces vs. hyphens are ignored.

models.description: Model names of this make, e.g. ["Model 3", "Model Y"]. Omit for every model of the make.

price_min_eur.description: Minimum `price_eur`, in whole euros. Cars without a price never match.

price_max_eur.description: Maximum `price_eur`, in whole euros. Cars without a price never match.

year_min.description: Earliest first-registration year. Cars without a registration date never match.

year_max.description: Latest first-registration year. Cars without a registration date never match.

mileage_max_km.description: Maximum odometer reading, in km. Cars without an odometer reading never match.

exterior_colors.description: Exterior colours, e.g. ["Blue", "White"]; a car matching any of them is included. Cars without a detected colour never match. `available_exterior_colors` in the result lists the colours on offer.

interior_colors.description: Interior colour: light and/or dark. A two-tone interior matches both.

sale_type.description: Only auctions ("from" price, the buyer bids) or only fixed-price "buy now" cars. Omit for both.

dutch_registered_only.description: true: only cars registered in the Netherlands. false or omitted: no filter.

towing_bar_only.description: true: only cars with a towing bar. false or omitted: no filter.

sort.description: Order of `cars`. default: Eccasion favourites first, then highest price (with sale_type "buy_now": favourites, then cars in stock, then highest price). newest_listed: most recently listed first. price_asc / price_desc, year_desc / year_asc, mileage_asc / mileage_desc: by price, registration year or mileage.

limit.description: How many of the matching cars to return, in the requested order: 1-50, default 20. `count` is always the full number of matches.
